name: @dev-centr/private-docs-login
description: A login provider for private documentation sites that use OpenID Connect. GitHub and GitLab org members sign in through their org's installation.
author: Ryan Johnson (https://github.com/AMDphreak)

scripts.cf:d1:create: cd deploy/cloudflare && npx --yes wrangler@4 d1 create private-docs-login-state
scripts.cf:d1:migrate: cd deploy/cloudflare && npx --yes wrangler@4 d1 migrations apply private-docs-login-state --remote
scripts.cf:secrets: node deploy/cloudflare/secrets.mjs && cd deploy/cloudflare && npx --yes wrangler@4 secret bulk ../../var/worker-secrets.json && cd ../.. && node deploy/cloudflare/secrets.mjs --clean
scripts.cf:tail: cd deploy/cloudflare && npx --yes wrangler@4 tail private-docs-login
